title: Admin Axe
body:
Unobtainable
The following content is not obtainable by any means.

Reason: This item is exclusive to developers.

"If a tree falls in a forest and no one is around to hear it, does it make a sound?"

Description

The Admin Axe is an admin tool obtainable only by using a Spawn Menu. Like the name implies, it's a tool used for ease of testing for tree cutting. It has maxed out stats, capable of one-shotting most trees in the game, having no charge and 50 studs of range.

Appearance

The Admin Axe is a medium sized hatchet with a glossy pink headpiece and pearly white handle. Headpiece is pink in color with the default legacy foil material applied to it. Handle is colored white, using the default legacy wood material.

It's model appears to derived from the Rusty Axe, minus the improvised grip.

Trivia

  • Early version of Admin Axe used to have a decal of the internet meme "Giga Chad" plastered over it's headpiece. DevShurikeno used to have a special variant of the Admin Axe, with a decal of...Twitch streamer XQC morphed into a Pepe the frog holding a pink heart plastered over it's headpiece.
  • Current design of Admin Axe seems to be heavily based upon the Alpha Axe of Testing from Lumber Tycoon 2.
  • Current design of Admin Axe uses the design first introduced in older Oaklands iteration - Oaklands Legacy.
  • "If a tree falls in a forest and no one is around to hear it, does it make a sound?" is a philosophical thought experiment that raises questions regarding observation and perception.
  • The admin axe was obtainable in the testing version of Oaklands
  • The admin axe as well as other admin tools are publicly usable in "Oaklands 100 Players", however this game is rarely unlocked by the developers.
